result.summary: The home screen has a broken restaurant card image (placeholder icon) and a few clipping/overflow issues on the popular listing.

issues.description: The Popular right now card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows a broken-image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo, leaving a large empty gray area.
issues.suggestion: Load a valid restaurant image or provide a branded fallback so the card is not empty.

issues.description: The €0 delivery badge on the Tokumaru card is clipped on the left by the card’s rounded corner.
issues.suggestion: Add inset/padding so the badge sits fully inside the rounded image container.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) control on the Tokumaru card sits on a circular gray background that is cut off by the card’s top-right corner.
issues.suggestion: Inset the icon from the card edge so the full circle is visible.
